title: Founder’s Associate – Business Development & Growth
description:
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Experience:** 0–2 years  
**Compensation:** ₹5–7 LPA  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Reporting to:** Founder/CEO  
**Role**  
Fluxton is looking for a **Founder’s Associate – Business Development & Growth** to work closely with the Founder across **business development, strategic partnerships, charging infrastructure expansion, government engagement, fundraising, and strategic initiatives.**  
This is an **office + field role** involving market research, stakeholder meetings, site visits, and execution. The role will have defined monthly and quarterly targets, along with ownership of strategic and ad-hoc projects.  
**Responsibilities**  
**Business Development**

* Identify and qualify customers, partners, and charging infrastructure opportunities.
* Identify and evaluate potential EV charging locations.
* Engage property owners, businesses, developers, fleet operators, fuel stations, CPOs, and other partners.
* Conduct outreach through calls, email, LinkedIn, events, and meetings.
* Build and manage customer, partnership, and location pipelines.
* Coordinate with property owners, CPOs, DISCOMs, contractors, suppliers, and internal teams.
* Coordinate site surveys, demos, and pilots.
* Prepare proposals, pitches, presentations, and partnership structures.
* Support negotiations and move opportunities through agreement and deployment.
* Identify opportunities across EV charging, solar, and BESS.
* Represent Fluxton at industry events and networking opportunities.

**Founder’s Office**

* Conduct market, competitor, and business research.
* Evaluate new markets, business opportunities, and strategic partnerships.
* Prepare presentations, briefs, and business material for the Founder.
* Coordinate strategic projects across teams and with external partners, consultants, and lawyers.
* Support the founder with meetings, follow-ups, and execution of key priorities.
* Take ownership of ad-hoc strategic and operational projects.

**Government & Corporate Affairs**

* Engage with government departments, PSUs, DISCOMs, and industry bodies.
* Track EV, energy, and infrastructure policies, schemes, tenders, EOIs, and RFPs.
* Support tender documentation, registrations, empanelments, government meetings, and PSU/institutional partnerships.

**Investor Relations & Fundraising**

* Research VCs, family offices, strategic investors, and potential introductions.
* Conduct investor outreach and coordinate meetings.
* Prepare and update pitch decks and fundraising material.
* Participate in investor pitches with the founder.
* Maintain the investor pipeline and support due diligence and information requests.

**Targets**  
Targets may include **qualified leads, customer/partner meetings, charging locations, site visits, proposals, pilots, commercial opportunities, partnerships, government/PSU opportunities, investor outreach, and strategic projects completed.**  
Targets may change based on company priorities.  
**Requirements**

* 0–2 years of experience; fresh graduates may apply.
* Strong communication, research, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable with field work, travel, and meeting new stakeholders.
* Strong organization, follow-up, and multitasking abilities.
* Comfortable working toward targets and handling ambiguity.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.

**Preferred**

* Experience/internships in **the Founder's Office, business development, sales, partnerships, consulting, strategy, or corporate affairs.**
* Interest in **EVs, energy, infrastructure, mobility, or climate technology.**
* Familiarity with fundraising, VC, government tenders, GeM, PSUs, or public procurement.
* Existing relationships across the EV, energy, infrastructure, real estate, government, startup, or investment ecosystem.

Pay: Up to ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Business Development Associate (Presales) - B2B Corporate Relations
description:
**Job Description**  
**About Newton School :**  
Newton School is an online EdTech platform dedicated to transforming tech education. We bridge the gap between academia and industry requirements by grooming millions of students into highly skilled software developers and tech professionals. Our mission is to build a superpower tech workforce and connect our highly trained graduates with top-tier companies globally.

**Role Overview**  
We are looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented **Business Development Associate (Presales)** to join our **B2B Sales team**. In this role, you will be the driving force behind expanding our network of corporate hiring partners. You will be responsible for identifying companies with active hiring needs, initiating first contact, pitching Newton School’s elite talent pool, and setting up successful onboarding pipelines. If you love the thrill of the chase, enjoy building relationships, and want to shape the future of tech hiring, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) :**

* **Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation:** Conduct outreach calls and emails to prospective corporate clients using both assigned lead databases and independent research to identify companies actively hiring for tech roles.
* **Corporate Onboarding & Inside Sales:** Conduct high-impact pitch calls to corporate HRs, Talent Acquisition Managers, and Engineering Leaders to showcase the value of hiring from Newton School and successfully onboard them as placement partners.
* **Market Intelligence & Growth Strategy:** Perform continuous market research on industry hiring trends, competitor analysis, and emerging sectors to build robust strategies for future business growth.
* **Data Hygiene & Reporting**: Maintain meticulous daily records of outreach activities, lead statuses, call logs, and follow-ups using Microsoft Excel and CRM tools to ensure data-driven decision-making.

​​​​**Key Proficiencies & Requirements :**

* **Excellent Communication Skills:** Outstanding verbal and written communication in English is non-negotiable. You should be able to articulate value propositions clearly and handle objections confidently.
* **Data Proficiency (Excel)**: Strong command over Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, data filtering) for tracking leads, managing databases, and generating daily reports.
* **Sales Acumen:** A natural hustle mindset with the ability to handle cold outreach, navigate gatekeepers, and engage decision-makers.
* **Education & Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in any stream. Prior experience in B2B sales, inside sales, lead generation, or corporate recruitment (especially in EdTech or HR Tech) is a major plus, though motivated freshers are welcome to apply.

**Preferred Traits :**

* **Persistence & Resilience:** A "never-give-up" attitude when dealing with cold leads and navigating complex corporate structures.
* **Self-Starter**: Ability to work autonomously, research niche tech companies, and find creative ways to get a foot in the door.
* **Adaptability**: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment where agility is key.

**What We Offer :**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Attractive fixed salary along with a lucrative, performance-linked incentive structure.
* **Career Growth:** A steep learning curve with fast-track career progression opportunities into core B2B Account Management or Sales Strategy.
* **Culture:** A vibrant, collaborative, and inclusive work environment that celebrates wins and fosters continuous learning.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your Current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?
* How soon can you join us?
* Are you okay to work On-site from Koramangala, Bengaluru (Mon-Fri)
* This role requires initial and cold outreach to companies. Would you be okay? If yes, only then apply.

Work Location: In person

title: Global People operations - Leaves Associate
description:
* Job ID: 907150
* 2 - 4 Years
* 1 Opening
* Bengaluru

  

### **Role description**

The **HR Generalist** is responsible for delivering expert People & Culture support and managing key employee lifecycle programs within a global shared services environment. Partnering with HRBPs and business stakeholders, this role drives the effective execution of HR programs, provides guidance on complex employee matters, and ensures consistent, high-quality employee experience across all entities.

At the center of the employee lifecycle, the HR Generalist is responsible for administering and enhancing core People Operations activities across multiple jurisdictions. Areas of focus include employee transactions and lifecycle events, promotions, employee support, HR systems administration, compliance activities, and employee data governance, ensuring services are delivered consistently and in alignment with global standards and local requirements. Through a customer-focused and solutions-oriented approach, the HR Generalist balances business needs, employee experience, and compliance while driving high-quality service delivery. The role also plays a critical part in strengthening processes, improving operational efficiency, and advancing operational excellence across the Global People Operations function.

**Core** **Responsibilities**:

* Serve as a trusted People & Culture resource by providing guidance on policies, programs, employee lifecycle processes, and employee inquiries, ensuring a positive and seamless employee experience across multiple jurisdictions.

* Execute and oversee employee lifecycle activities, including workforce changes, promotions, compensation updates, employee documentation, and separations through HR Help Desk platforms, ensuring timely resolution and adherence to service level expectations.

* Manage employee cases and service requests, researching and resolving inquiries while maintaining a high standard of customer service and operational excellence.

* Collaborate with HR Business Partners and Centers of Excellence, including Benefits, Employee Relations, Immigration, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and Learning teams, to resolve or assist employees related to cross-functional employee matters and support business priorities.

* Maintain the integrity of employee data and HR systems through transaction processing, audits, record maintenance, quality reviews, and adherence to data governance standards.

* Support compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws, company policies, regulatory requirements, and documentation standards through accurate administration and process execution.

* Produce, analyze, and interpret People & Culture metrics, operational reports, and workforce data to support business decisions, compliance requirements, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Develop and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, and self-service resources that promote consistency, scalability, and operational efficiency.

* Identify and implement process improvements by leveraging HR technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to enhance efficiency, service delivery, and employee experience.

* Develop expertise in assigned People Operations processes and provide guidance, training, and support to employees and team members while promoting standardization and best practices.

* Participate in projects and strategic initiatives, including technology implementations, process transformations, acquisitions/integrations, and organizational changes that strengthen the Global People Operations operating model.

* Build knowledge of the firm's strategy, service lines, and business priorities to effectively support organizational objectives and contribute to an exceptional employee experience.

* Perform other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications (Personal Characteristics, Skills/Abilities, Academic):**

* Master’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field.

* 3 – 5 years of experience in an HR Generalist, HR Operations, People Operations, or shared services environment.

* Experience supporting complex employee lifecycle processes across multiple jurisdictions, including employee transactions, workforce changes, employee data management, and compliance activities.

* Experience serving as a subject matter expert and escalation point for complex employee lifecycle processes, employee inquiries, and operational issues.

* Strong prioritization skills with the ability to manage competing demands and support multiple stakeholders across different business areas

* Highly collaborative and action-oriented, with the ability to build relationships and influence within a matrixed organization

* Strong initiative and accountability, with a hands-on approach and willingness to take ownership

* Excellent customer service, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills

* Ability to collaborate effectively across global, cross-functional, and onshore/offshore teams

* Professionalism and results orientation, with a commitment to continuous learning and development

* Operational mindset with the ability to leverage data and insights to solve problems and drive execution

* Experience in HR/ ERP tools/ systems (preferably Oracle), service management platforms, and related technologies for at least 1 year

* Demonstrated ability to interpret policies, resolve complex employee issues, and manage competing priorities

* Solid PC skills with proficiency in MS Office (Advanced Excel, PowerBI, Macros).

* A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for enhancing processes, service delivery, and employee experience.

  

**About Grant Thornton INDUS**
------------------------------

Grant Thornton INDUS is the global capability center for Grant Thornton US, the U.S. member firm of Grant Thornton International Ltd., a leading global network of independent audit, tax, and advisory firms. Founded in Chicago in 1924, Grant Thornton US is one of the leading accounting and advisory firms in the U.S., bringing together $4B+ in revenue, 56 U.S. offices, and a multi-national platform spanning 20 countries with 25,000 people. It combines deep expertise, advanced technology, and a collaborative mindset to help clients solve complex challenges and grow with confidence. Since 2012, Grant Thornton INDUS has brought together 3,300+ professionals across Tax, Audit, Advisory, Client Services, Innovation, and Enabling Functions to deliver high-impact solutions for Grant Thornton US and its global network. Recognized as a Great Place To Work® for three consecutive years and among India’s Top 15 Best Workplaces™ in Professional Services 2026, INDUS offers a high-performance culture where people are trusted, supported, and empowered to grow.

title: Trade Lifecycle Associate I
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Step into the role of Trade Lifecycle Associate I at JPMorganChase, where you'll be a vital part of managing the pre- and post-trading life cycle. Your expertise in cash movements and funding coordination will be essential in ensuring seamless trade processing and operational excellence.  
  
As a Trade Lifecycle Associate I within JPMorganChase, you will play a pivotal role in managing the operations of the pre- and post-trading life cycle across all asset classes. Your expertise in cash movements, funding, and coordination with other business lines will ensure seamless trade processing on our platforms. You will leverage your broad knowledge of trade lifecycle principles and practices to propose and implement improvements to our current working methods. Your role will involve diverse activities requiring analysis and judgement within defined boundaries, and you will often be responsible for guiding the work of others. Your proficiency in listening and questioning, internal stakeholder management, presentation skills, process improvement, and automation will be key to your success in this role. You will also have the opportunity to develop your data and tech literacy skills while working with us.  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Providing the supervisory support, in the day to day management of the business deliverables of the team, such as release of trade instructions, reopening and settlement of trades from the core settlement systems, inventory/position management and inter-company reconciliation prior to settlement date, among others.
* Accountability for service quality of the team. Ensure operational procedures are followed and that tasks are completed in an accurate and timely manner.
* Provide first level of supervision to the staff during business hours.
* Support the process Vice President in their mission to provide top quality operations in support of this global business.
* Ensure that procedures are documented and that the documentation is updated periodically.
* Identify requirements for additional controls
* Daily investigation and escalation of any issues
* Provide daily/weekly statistics
* Participate in global and local projects including new business, system enhancements and market rule changes.
* Process re-engineering to enhance efficiency and controls

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* graduate with Minimum 7 years of experience in Banking and Financial Services/ Treasury environment or related function.
* Familiarity with products and services.
* Experience in Trade Management & Settlements.
* Flexibility to work on holidays / extended working hours on high volume days, if required.
* Good PC skills including Microsoft office products (Excel, Word, Power Point, Access).
* Good written & spoken English communication skills, exhibits effective communication with key stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Prior custody/treasury operation services, markets operational experience.
* Understanding of SWIFT, Cross Border Payments, Foreign Exchange, Trade life cycle, Reconciliation rules and Global Custody.
* Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.
